title: Quietly Juicy Vietnamese Penne Rigate Pasta
description: A romantic and herbal Vietnamese dish featuring penne rigate, simmered to perfection in a low-sodium friendly broth.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne rigate pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and cook the chicken breast until browned and cooked through.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and lime juice.
Pour the fish sauce mixture over the chicken and garlic in the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked penne rigate pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
Simmer the pasta and sauce over low heat for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
